meta.title: Product page reads
meta.dek: Three ways to read price and stock on the product page. Move the inputs, change each approach's settings, switch scenarios, feel the wait, then choose one and copy the decision.

theme.concept: A plain engineering console: white surfaces, one accent for the choice, green and red for budgets.

sources.label: Datadog
sources.detail: Traffic and query timings (invented for this example).

sources.label: Simulation model
sources.detail: Computed from the formulas in solutions.json.

chapters.title: What breaks where
chapters.dek: Each approach misses a budget in a different scenario, at its own settings.

items.title: Query the database
items.text: The replicas run out: {{solutions.sale.direct.errors|dec1}} of reads fail and the rest wait {{solutions.sale.direct.p95_ms|int}}, the timeout.

items.title: Read through a cache
items.text: Misses reach the slow database, so the p95 read takes {{solutions.slow_db.cache.p95_ms|int}}. Serving the old entry while refreshing hides the miss and doubles the age of a price.

items.title: Read a view kept by events
items.text: The consumers fall behind and the oldest price shown is {{solutions.reprice.view.stale_s|int}} old. More consumers close the gap for {{solutions.typical.view.cost}} a month at the usual settings.
